```yaml
name: Test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with:
        go-version: 'stable'

    - name: Run tests
      run: make test
```
